edits:
concurrency:
  group: deploy-lambdas-production
  cancel-in-progress: false
concurrency:
  group: deploy-lambdas-production
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max

concurrency:
  group: run-ops-direct
  cancel-in-progress: false
concurrency:
  group: run-ops-direct
  cancel-in-progress: false
  queue: max
          git commit -q -m "ops(direct): report from run ${{ github.run_id }} [skip-deploy] [skip-ops]" || { echo "nothing to commit"; exit 0; }
          for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do git pull --rebase -q origin main && git push -q origin HEAD:main && break || sleep $((i * 7)); done
          git commit -q -m "ops(direct): report from run ${{ github.run_id }} [skip-deploy] [skip-ops]" || { echo "nothing to commit"; exit 0; }
          # 2026-10-08 (ops 6497): a script that regenerates a tracked file (engine-manifest.json) left the
          # checkout dirty, `pull --rebase` refused five times and the run still went green with its report
          # lost. Discard everything that is not the committed report, and fail loudly if the push never lands.
          git stash -q -u || true
          pushed=0
          for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do
            if git pull --rebase -q origin main && git push -q origin HEAD:main; then pushed=1; break; fi
            sleep $((i * 7))
          done
          [ "$pushed" = 1 ] || { echo "::error::report commit could not be pushed to main after 5 attempts"; exit 1; }
